# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file enables GitHub Copilot to use project-specific coding guidelines.

**All coding agent instructions are maintained in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository root.

Please refer to `AGENTS.md` for:

- Build/Run/Test commands
- Branching and versioning conventions
- Code style guidelines (imports, naming, formatting)
- Project structure and module patterns
- Testing conventions
- Specification workflow
- Documentation standards
